content_sections.heading: IIT Goa Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Goa Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Goa Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Goa Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Sports Coach (Badminton), 1 for Sports Coach (Football), and 1 for Sports Coach (Lawn Tennis).

content_sections.heading: IIT Goa Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Sports Coach (Badminton) : Graduate in Physical Education, should have specialized in Badminton, should have represented University in Inter University Sports Meet or State or National, should have a minimum of two years of coaching Experience. OR NIS coaching diploma / NIS certificate course. Should have represented University in the Inter university sports Meet or state or National. Should have a minimum of two years of coaching experience. OR Having represented state or national with a coaching certificate with 2 years of experience issued by the respective Sports/club authority. Preference will be given to experienced candidates with IIT Sports Scenario. Sports Coach (Football) : Graduate in Physical Education, should have specialized in Football, should have represented University in Inter University Sports Meet or State or National, should have a minimum of two years of coaching Experience. OR NIS coaching diploma / NIS certificate course. Should have represented University in the Inter university sports Meet or state or National. Should have a minimum of two years of coaching experience. OR Having represented state or national with a coaching certificate with 2 years of experience issued by the respective Sports/club authority. Preference will be given to experienced candidates with IIT Sports Scenario. Sports Coach (Lawn Tennis) : Graduate in Physical Education, should have specialized in Lawn Tennis, should have represented University in Inter University Sports Meet or State or National, should have a minimum of two years of coaching Experience. OR NIS coaching diploma / NIS certificate course. Should have represented University in the Inter university sports Meet or state or National. Should have a minimum of two years of coaching experience. OR Having represented state or national with a coaching certificate with 2 years of experience issued by the respective Sports/club authority. Preference will be given to experienced candidates with IIT Sports Scenario.

content_sections.heading: IIT Goa Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: The salary for the Sports Coach position is Rs. 385 Per Hour.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Goa Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Goa?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Sports Coach posts at IIT Goa is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Sports Coach position at IIT Goa?
faq.answer: The salary for the Sports Coach position at IIT Goa is Rs. 385 Per Hour. This is a part-time job opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Sports Coach post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Sports Coach position at IIT Goa. These vacancies are for specific sports disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Sports Coach role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate degree in Physical Education with specialization in the relevant sport and have at least 2 years of coaching experience. A NIS coaching diploma/certificate course with 2 years of experience is also accepted.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the IIT Goa Sports Coach recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Sports Coach posts at IIT Goa?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Sports Coach posts at IIT Goa will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for IIT Goa Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the IIT Goa office in Ponda, Goa (Pincode: 403401). Specific reporting time will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with state or national representation apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates who have represented their state or national level in sports and possess a coaching certificate with 2 years of experience are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Sports Coach position at IIT Goa is Part Time.
